data.one_liner: Utilities to apply correct system Chinese fonts with precise weight and to load custom Chinese fonts at runtime.
data.what_it_does: Adds extensions to TextStyle, TextTheme and ThemeData to map Chinese characters to system fonts with accurate fontWeight handling. Allows downloading or loading custom Chinese fonts from URL, assets or files dynamically.
use_when: You need correct Chinese font weight rendering across platforms
You want to load large Chinese fonts on demand rather than bundling them
avoid_when: You don't need special Chinese font handling
Your app targets platforms where the package hasn't been verified (e.g., Linux)
strengths: Dynamic font loading from web, assets, or file
weaknesses: Limited to Chinese fonts; not a general font manager
